label: Lithium Carbonate (China spot)
delta: -6% from Q1 2026 peak; spiked to ~$27,600 (mid-May), then retreated
deltaNote: Price spiked to ~200,500 CNY/T (~$27,600/tonne) on May 13 — a two-year high — driven by supply restarts in response to Q1 2026 rally, then retreated to ~177,000 CNY/T (~$24,400/tonne) by May 27 as producers responded with supply. Still 67% below Nov 2022 peak. Volatility reflects thin liquidity and sensitivity to policy-driven supply shocks.

label: Best Solid-State Energy Density (production-stage)
source: Ganfeng Lithium small-batch production (May 2026); CAS lab result 451.5 Wh/kg (May 2026)
contestNote: Ganfeng's 500 Wh/kg cell entered small-batch production in May 2026 (dozens–hundreds of cells/day), with 400 Wh/kg variant at 1,100+ cycle validation. CAS published 451.5 Wh/kg with 20C rate (3-min charge) and nail-penetration safety pass. Commercial automotive solid-state packs remain ~250–300 Wh/kg. Basquevolt (Spain) launched 402 Wh/kg hybrid polymer cell commercially May 22, 2026.

label: Fastest EV Battery Charging Rate (announced)
source: CATL Qilin 3 (3rd-gen) — CATL Tech Day, Apr 21, 2026
contestNote: CATL Tech Day announcement; production vehicle qualification ongoing with three unnamed OEMs for 2027. Requires ~1,000 kW charger infrastructure not yet widely deployed. 3rd-gen Shenxing LFP achieves 10-80% in 3m44s. Real-world rates will be constrained by charging network capacity.
deltaNote: CATL's 1st-gen Shenxing (2024) achieved 4C; Qilin 3 claims 10C continuous with 3,000 kW output — enabling ~400 km recovered in under 5 minutes. Targets 1,000+ km WLTP range in premium vehicle platform. If achieved commercially, eliminates fast-charging as an EV objection.
